commands: python3 empirical_bridge.py windows --cohort COHORT.json --seed INTEGER --output NEW_WINDOWS.jsonl
python3 empirical_bridge.py reduce --cohort COHORT.json --estimates FITS.json --output NEW_REDUCTION.jsonl
python3 empirical_bridge.py compare --cohort COHORT.json --estimates CANDIDATE.json --reference PROTECTED_REFERENCE.json --output NEW_COMPARISON.jsonl
endpoint: Reconstruct the complete four-estimator per-unit Figure7C table and method-specific pseudo-REE distributions from the paper's full5775-unit/26-mouse empirical population; includes every failure and sequential exclusion mask.
execution: Portable commands are templates for future separately admitted original inputs. Packaging checks use generated JSON only; no authentic run is selected. External resource/custody owner required.

input_contract.actual_input_generation: Reuse official acquisition/estimator code only after correcting its paper/QC/configuration mismatches with a reviewed source binding. No invented native adapter issues scientific source authority.
input_contract.cohort: Exactly5775 unique pseudonym unit IDs across26 mouse IDs with session/area/fr_hz/lv metadata. source_sha256 is a syntactic declaration; external custody must authenticate the actual original source and cohort. No authentic roster is included.
input_contract.estimates: All23100unit×method rows, including failures; tau_bins, finite or null R², explicit failure_reason for missing fit fields. Cohort and method coordinates checked before reduction.
input_contract.no_train_test_split_invented: This is unsupervised within-unit estimator reconstruction; no paper train/test split exists for this endpoint. Preparation/exposed reproduction and constrained-data improvement remain distinct.
input_contract.sampling: 30kHz integer ticks; full30-minute signal,40 one-second windows; uniform starts0..L-T inclusive, half-open extraction, repeats/overlap retained. Newly selected seed and fixed unit order are preserved; replicate0 Figure7C only. New draws are prospective replication, not recovered historical RNG.

paired_conditions.A: Paper+identical authentic data+common dependencies+public task contract.
paired_conditions.B: Same, plus pinned official output-free analysis source and required GPL-3.0 notices.
paired_conditions.equalities: Same frozen cohort, unit identity, trial windows, failure policy, observed execution budgets and targets. Authoring/model provenance and access isolation are still external unqualified obligations.
paired_conditions.improvement: Not implemented or scored by this bridge. A later estimator must receive only selected trials, while trusted full-recording pseudo references stay outside its prediction input; otherwise copying them defeats the low-data endpoint.
paired_conditions.reproduction: Both conditions reconstruct all four fits from full recordings and shared trials.

reduction.comparison: All5775×4coordinates including failures. Any candidate/reference availability mismatch disables all comparable MAE/max summaries; expected and observed counts and exact mismatches remain. Quantities remain separate; no invented pass tolerance or mixed-unit scalar.
reduction.exclusions: First any missing fit/covariate across allfour methods, then anynegativeR2 across allfour. ZeroR2 remains. Every originalrow and both diagnostics remain in report.
reduction.invalid_denominators: Nonpositive full-reference tau or nonfinite pseudo-REE retains every complete-case denominator; affected median/percentages are null and numeric_complete=false. Nonrepresentable tau_ms, difference or summary arithmetic raises ValueError before returning a report, rather than supplying a numeric result.
reduction.join_semantics: Identity joins byunit ID. Notebook's positional pandas indexing is not reproduced as a biological correspondence guarantee.
reduction.reference_pairing: PearsonR trials versus full ACF; concatenatediSTTC trials versus fulliSTTC;100*abs(trial-full)/full. Full-recording estimators are pseudo references, not biological ground truth.
reduction.tau_conversion: tau_ms=50*tau_bins; mathematical pseudoREE ratios are computed in bins and are unit invariant.
reduction.thresholds: Inclusive [0,100], [0,75], [0,50], [0,25] percentages on the source-defined complete-case population; complete error distributions and medians retained.

resource_design: Each input<=16MiB; fresh output<=64MiB. These are logical byte bounds, not hard RSS/CPU/wall/isolation controls. Window generation streams by unit; compare/reduce retain full validated tables. Authentic resource sufficiency and external execution ownership remain unqualified.

rights.code: This benchmark-authored component is distributed under GNU GPL version3; LICENSE and NOTICE.md are included. No official notebook or sampler body is bundled.
rights.data: Allen data terms remain separate. No biologicaldata republished; complete original acquisition license and public redistribution qualification unresolved.
rights.paper: Primary paper linked for attribution; no article or publisher media body is included.

scientific_limits: This component does not fit estimators or reconstruct Figure7C inferential GLMs/p-values, fullFigure7B/D-G, S12-S14, or the entire paper.
Its exact source-grounded reduction and trial-window preparation are useful missing bridges, not a complete accepted paper task.
Authentic full-cohort/QC reconciliation and independently qualified native estimator producer remain unresolved. No original roster or answer is invented.
Historical 3053 complete cases are a reported result, never a target count imposed by selecting rows.
